name: about-stats
description: About section with centered narrative, stat cards with icons, and optional trust strip of partner logos

ai.whenToUse: Use for company/team introduction with key metrics. Great after a hero section to build credibility. Works well for SaaS, agencies, and product pages that want to combine narrative with social proof numbers.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use if you don't have meaningful stats to showcase. Avoid on minimal landing pages where a simple text block suffices.

badge.description: Small eyebrow label above the title (e.g. 'Our Mission')

description.description: Supporting paragraph about the company or team
description.example: We're a team of designers and engineers obsessed with performance, accessibility, and beautiful interfaces.

stats.description: Stat cards with icon, value, subtitle, and description

trustLabels.description: Optional list of partner/client names for social proof strip
